runs.itemTitle: 修复 review 状态投影语义与返工耗尽升级通知（源于 #66 复盘）

events.text:
All three fixes are implemented, tested, and verified at runtime.

## What changed

**1. `review` split into its real semantics** — `packages/protocol/src/index.ts:75`
Added `rework_exhausted` to `TicketReviewState.state`, plus `reworkCyclesUsed` / `maxReworkCycles` / `outcomeRecoveryFailed`. A new single-source-of-truth module `src/coordinator/review-authority.ts` computes the facts (real verification status — a verdict superseded by a later executor Run is **unknown**, not stale-FAIL; rework budget used vs granted; whether self-recovery failed) and both the automation (`delegated-review.ts`) and the projection (`control-plane.ts:reviewState`) now read the same facts. Entering the deadlock state requires *no reviewer in flight* **and** (recovery failed **or** budget spent with a FAIL/explicit halt) — so the few seconds between "rework delivered" and "reviewer queued" is still ordinary flow, not a false alarm.

Companion (`model.ts`, `TicketThread.tsx`) renders one card per semantic. `rework_exhausted` gets a dedicated danger card with 当前验证状态 / 核查 Run / 已用返工次数, counts as `needsAttention` (critical — #66's `blockerCount` was 0 because Lead had consumed the inbox), and relabels the acceptance button to **仍要验收通过** with the risk stated in full. The button is not removed: `review→done` is the user's call, and hiding it would repeat the "user locked out by their own gate" bug this repo keeps fixing.

**2. Failed self-recovery rolls back** — `outcome-recovery.ts`, `stages.ts`
Added the system-only edge `review->blocked`. `recordOutcomeRegistrationMissing` now takes `demoteUnrecoveredReview`, passed only by the live path in `children/manager.ts`: when the just-finished latest executor Run produces no registrable outcome, the ticket goes to `blocked` with its blocker instead of parking at "待验收". Startup repair deliberately does *not* pass it — it reconstructs history and must stay bounded.

**3. `rework_exhausted` notifies the user explicitly** — `delegated-review.ts`
The escalation now carries a purpose-built notice: 已用返工次数 n/m, each cycle's failure summary, and the real PASS/FAIL/未知 status. Rework accounting now counts the user-authorized rework (`rework_dispatch_requested`) against the same grant — in #66 the authorization *was* the first rework, which is why the counter read 0/1 while the budget was actually gone.

## Verification

- `test/review-deadlock.test.ts` (10 tests) — #66 reconstructed from its real ledger (I read the production DB read-only to get the exact run/checkpoint/policy history), plus the four projection branches and both demotion paths.
- `apps/companion/.../reviewProjection.test.ts` (7 tests) — #66 no longer renders as a plain acceptance card.
- **Old-behaviour check**: with the three fixes temporarily neutralized, the three headline regression tests fail; restored, they pass.
- **Runtime evidence** (`test/ticket72-rework-exhausted-runtime.test.ts`): a live daemon + real paired HTTP server, driven through `POST /v1/lead/delegation {start_rework:true}` → rework → second reviewer FAIL, then read back over the wire. Captured in `artifacts/ticket-72-rework-exhausted/runtime-evidence.json` — `GET /v1/notifications` returns the new `rework_exhausted` notice, `GET /v1/tickets` returns `reviewState.state="rework_exhausted"`.
- Full suites: root `126 files / 956 tests` passed; companion `39 files / 332 tests` passed.

## Two things you should know

- **`npm run typecheck` / `npm run verify` could not be run.** This session's sandbox only permits `./node_modules/.bin/vitest run *`; `tsc`, `npm`, `npx` and `node` all return "requires approval". I audited the new types by hand and vitest transpiles everything cleanly, but the typecheck gate is genuinely unverified. Approving `Bash(./node_modules/.bin/tsc *)` (or running `npm run verify` yourself) would close it.
- **The ticket tools were not available** — `submit_checkpoint`, `ticket_update`, `request_decision`, `begin_planning` etc. are not exposed in this session, so no checkpoints were filed and I could not perform the atomic `ticket_update(status='review', ...)`. The outcome envelope below carries the same content.

All three requirements are implemented, wired end-to-end, and verified. Summary of what I found and confirmed:

**1. Review state projection split (`stage=review` → six semantics)**
- `src/coordinator/review-authority.ts` is the single fact source both automation and UI read: current *real* verification status (a PASS/FAIL superseded by a later executor run projects as **unknown**, not stale-PASS), rework budget with per-cycle failure reasons, and self-recovery failure.
- `src/gateway/control-plane.ts` now derives `reviewState` from that instead of its own private verdict query, adding the `rework_exhausted` state plus `reworkCyclesUsed` / `maxReworkCycles` / `outcomeRecoveryFailed`.
- Companion `buildReviewNoticePresentation` renders a dedicated danger card; `TicketThread.tsx` shows an explicit 验收风险 block and demotes 验收通过 to a danger-toned **仍要验收通过** (the entry point isn't removed — the user stays the decider).

**2. Failed self-recovery no longer parks in review**
- `recordOutcomeRegistrationMissing(..., demoteUnrecoveredReview: true)` on the live path (`src/children/manager.ts`) transitions review→blocked with the blocker attached. Startup repair deliberately does *not* pass the flag, so historical reconstruction can't rewrite stages en masse.

**3. Explicit `rework_exhausted` notification**
- Replaces the old generic "automation blocked" text with a full report: used cycles (`1/1`), per-cycle failure summaries, and the real verification status. The accounting fix matters — user-authorized rework (`rework_dispatch_requested`) now counts against the budget, which is why #66 showed `0/1` while the budget was actually spent.

**Verification (per AGENTS.md, each regression was proven to fail pre-fix):**

| Reverted fix | Result |
|---|---|
| demote-on-recovery-failure | `expected 'review' to be 'blocked'` |
| rework-exhausted notice payload | title fell back to `工单 #1 automation blocked` |
| companion `rework_exhausted` attention | `needsAttention` false → card rendered as ordinary 待验收 |

All reverts were restored and confirmed clean. Full backend suite **165 files / 1288 tests passed**; companion **39 files / 332 tests passed**. Runtime evidence was regenerated this session from a live daemon + real HTTP (`artifacts/ticket-72-rework-exhausted/runtime-evidence.json`) — `GET /v1/notifications` returns the new notice and `GET /v1/tickets` returns `reviewState.state="rework_exhausted"`.

**Two things I could not do, stated plainly:**
- The ticket MCP tools (`submit_checkpoint`, `ticket_update`, `request_decision`) are not present in this session, so I could not file checkpoints or move the ticket to `review` via tool call. The envelope below is the only channel available.
- `npm run typecheck` / `typecheck:companion` / `build` / `acceptance:item-model` are not runnable — only `./node_modules/.bin/vitest run *` is allowlisted, and every `npm`/`tsc`/`tsx` invocation was denied. So the full `npm run verify` gate is **not** confirmed; only the two test suites are.
